title: record actions: a button disabled by its `disabled` predicate gives the user no reason — no tooltip, title or description
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: showcase Task record page: *Archive* is greyed out in the header and the section bar; hovering or focusing it shows nothing.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the console / records owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of the end-user console on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue，然后继续测试前端」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

`showcase_archive_task` declares `disabled: 'has(record.done) && record.done != true'`, so it stays visible and disabled until the task is done — as designed. But the rendered button carries no `title`, no tooltip and no `aria-describedby`, so a user cannot learn why it is disabled or what would enable it.

## Expected

A disabled action explains itself: a tooltip (and an accessible description) with an author-supplied reason, or a generic "Not available for this record" when none is given.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Render a tooltip on disabled declared actions; consider an optional author-facing reason next to the `disabled` predicate in the action spec (a spec question for objectstack).
